title: Nat Cole, the 'sugar pie'
summary: Humes recalls Nat Cole as a nice person who deserved his success, although Dance regrets that he played less piano as he became successful.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Yeah. You know there's a pianist that I should just mention too and that is, Nat Cole.
Yeah, he was the sugar pie.
Didn't he though. And he was such a nice person.
Yeah, a good guy, wasn't he?
He was a guy that did deserve it, didn't he?
The only thing I used to fear was as good as he played piano, and then when he got successful you just didn't hear him play that much piano.
